findings.message: At launch speed 10 the apex is at y=60, which is 170 px above the launch line. The scale is 40 px/m (5.102 m gives 204 px), so the ball appears to be clamped or scaled differently. The scale is probably 33.3 px/m, since 5.102 m × 33.3 = 170. At speed 5, 1.2755 m gives 42.5 px, which is also 33.3 px/m, so the scale is consistent. This is not an error.

At t=0 the Motion arrow is 60 px long for v=5. At v=2.5 it is 30 px, so the length is proportional to v. This supports the 'shortens while rising' observation. The arrow is absent at the top and points down when falling. The gravity arrow stays at 48 px in every frame. The traces support all three observations and the claim.
